summary: Add the plastic_trash_bin.glb model to the canonical public model inventory as a standalone asset, without registering a new runtime/catalog module yet.

impactAnalysis.notes: The GLB is added to public/models but is intentionally not referenced by catalog, state factories, renderer, placement, or BOM yet. Existing open asset hygiene/provenance findings F-033 and F-034 remain open and are explicitly reviewed. F-014 is not changed because no runtime module is being admitted by this PR.

e2e.reason: public/ asset changes are browser-impacting under the system contract; Chromium verifies the GLB is served and retains a valid binary glTF header.

risk.notes: The change adds one standalone binary asset and tests only; no runtime module, catalog entry, placement behavior, state schema, or BOM behavior changes.

migration.notes: No persisted data or runtime schema changes are introduced.

rollback: Remove public/models/plastic_trash_bin.glb and its two asset-validation tests if the asset is invalid or should not ship.
